definitions.explanation: The act of adding new space or rooms to an existing building, or the added section itself.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{増築|ぞうちく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We added an extension because our family grew.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二階|にかい}→二階：27513_nikai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{増築|ぞうちく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are plans to add a second floor.

examples.japanese: {増築|ぞうちく}⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{許可|きょか}→許可：00259_kyoka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: A permit is required for extension construction.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{増|ぞう} (increase, add) + {築|ちく} (construction, building)

VERB FORM:
・{増築|ぞうちく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to extend, add to a building)

RELATED CONSTRUCTION TERMS:
・⟦{新築|しんちく}→新築：06567_shinchiku⟧ (new construction)
・⟦{改築|かいちく}→改築：06224_kaichiku⟧ (renovation, structural alteration)
・⟦{修繕|しゅうぜん}→修繕：06569_shuuzen⟧ (repair)
・⟦{建|た}て{増|ま}し→建て増し：30018_tatemashi⟧ (building addition - more casual)
・⟦リフォーム→リフォーム：08821_rifoomu⟧ (remodeling - loanword)

PERMIT REQUIREMENTS:
In Japan, {増築|ぞうちく} often requires:
・⟦{建築確認申請|けんちくかくにんしんせい}→建築確認申請：noentry⟧ (building permit application)
・Verification of ⟦{建|けん}ぺい{率|りつ}→建ぺい率：30019_kenpeiritsu⟧ (building coverage ratio)
・Verification of ⟦{容積率|ようせきりつ}→容積率：30020_yousekiritsu⟧ (floor area ratio)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{増築|ぞうちく}⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧ (extension work/construction)
・{増築|ぞうちく}⟦{部分|ぶぶん}→部分：03715_bubun⟧ (extended portion)
・{増築|ぞうちく}⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧ (extension costs)
・{増築|ぞうちく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{許可|きょか}→許可：00259_kyoka⟧ (building extension permit)
